name: Claire Hikari no Densetsu - Chapter 3 - Botsuraku
original_name: クレール光の伝説 第三章 没落
source:
With the witch's magic the evil hands of the orcs have finally approached Hahn's castle. Even Queen Hildegard won't escape humiliation.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-june-2003-sayonara.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
在女巫魔法的幫助下，獸人的魔爪終於伸向了哈恩城堡。就連希爾德加德王后，也無法逃脫凌辱的命運。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-june-2003-sayonara.html]vndbreview[/url]]
